title: Sweet Chilli Sauce
description: A Thai-inspired sweet and spicy sauce — sticky, tangy, and addictive. Perfect as a dip or glaze.

method.instruction: In a small saucepan, combine water, vinegar, sugar, chilli garlic sauce, and minced garlic.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves completely.
In a small bowl, mix cornflour with 1 tablespoon of cold water to form a smooth slurry. Add to the saucepan.
Continue stirring until the sauce thickens, about 2–3 minutes.
Remove from heat and allow to cool. Transfer to a clean jar and store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Excellent with spring rolls, fried chicken, or as a marinade. Can also be used as a dipping sauce for dumplings or drizzled over grilled meats.
